error: The headline claim says its population is all orders, while the spec and its own caveats say delivered orders.
warning_texts: The claims machine gate has no rule that binds claim.population to audit_spec.yaml population.name or to the filters used by claims_recomputed, so a relabelled population can pass that gate.
CLM-NET-REVENUE caveats name delivered orders only while the population field names all orders inside the period, which is why caveats_declared.CLM-NET-REVENUE passed.
summary: Five claim values recompute from raw_data/orders.csv on delivered orders in 2025-01-01..2025-03-30 (net 35741.52, refund rate 0.473684 = 27/57, PL 11181.67, DE 11032.61, CZ 13527.24). CLM-NET-REVENUE.population is labelled all orders inside the period, which on raw nets 41881.34 over 200 rows, not the published 35741.52 over 174 delivered rows.
